responsibility: This is the core implementation of mc’s declaration, symbol, scope, and AST engine. It defines the node variants for modules, declarations, types, statements, and expressions; manages module universes and nested scopes via symbol trees and indexes; builds predefined and SYSTEM symbols; records source/comment metadata; and performs final pretty-printed output in C, C++, or Modula-2. In practice this file is the semantic backbone shared by all parser passes and the eventual code generator.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is decl’s implementation body: it defines the concrete AST/declaration node variants and global compiler state and implements symbol, scope, builtin, and emission behavior, whereas the same-named .def file only exposes that functionality through an opaque node interface.
